risks: Compliance with Russian laws could limit competition with foreign companies.
The Russian government may develop a national search engine, creating additional competition.
Nebius Group faces significant tax risks in Russia, including potential penalties and fines.
We may face delays in pursuing acquisition opportunities due to difficulty in obtaining audited financial statements.
Nebius Group may face fines or sanctions if it fails to obtain and maintain required licenses, permits or registrations.

growth_drivers: Nebius Group N.V. introduced autonomous driving technology and an edtech platform, and signed long-term contracts with Microsoft and Meta.
Nebius AI cloud business revenues increased by $412.0 million, or 603%, from $68.3 million in 2024 to $480.3 million in 2025.
Revenues from TripleTen increased by $25.3 million, or 88%, from $28.8 million in 2024 to $54.1 million in 2025.
The company generated $80.6 million in other income, primarily from investments in money market funds.
Net cash provided by operating activities increased to $401.9 million in 2025 due to strategic customer agreements and improved operating margins.
risks: The company accrued a contingent tax liability of $180.9 million in the fourth quarter of 2024.
Management judgment is required in recognizing and measuring deferred tax assets and lease liabilities, which could impact future income tax expense and results of operations.
Revisions to lease term or discount rate assumptions could materially affect financial position and results of operations.

growth_drivers: Nebius closed 4 landmark deals this quarter, each for an average of over $1 billion.
Revenue grew 454% to $582 million, with the Nebius AI business generating 98% of group revenue.
Prepayments from customers reached an all-time high, bringing in more than $9 billion of upfront funding this year.
Nebius launched a successful capacity auction, clearing at 15% above the highest price charged before.
risks: We are building capacity for 2027 demand, supported by customer commitments.

growth_drivers: Nebius secured $1 billion deals in its AI cloud business.
The company expects to sell its entire 2027 capacity.
Vera Rubins are easier to develop technically than Grace Blackwells.
Customers are bolstering their own models, increasing demand for inference and grounding.
risks: Almost all of the 5 gigawatts capacity will come online over the next 3 to 3.5 years.
